title: How's my business doing? QuickBooks can answer that with a new Plugin in ChatGPT
summary: Get a quick summary of the QuickBooks Plugin in ChatGPT and learn how it can help your business.
body_markdown:
### Keep payroll in check


**5. Analyze payroll costs:** Understand what’s driving your payroll spend and why it changed. Ask for an analysis of your latest payroll to see the factors behind changes such as overtime, headcount, pay rates, employer taxes, or seasonality, and get practical insights that can help you manage costs.


**6. Payroll employee onboarding:** Get a new hire set up in


[QuickBooks Payroll](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/product-update/workforce-human-capital-management-payroll/) using the information you already have. Provide employee details or source documents, such as an offer letter or employee roster, the skill to help create the employee, assign their work location and initial pay, and identify any remaining steps needed to get them payroll-ready.


**7. Set base pay:** View and manage employee base pay through the conversation. Ask to review an employee’s current salary or hourly rate, give a raise, adjust pay, switch between salary and hourly compensation, or update contracted hours. You’ll review and confirm any change before it’s made in QuickBooks Payroll.


**8. Payroll help:** Get quick answers about your payroll setup and employees using your connected QuickBooks Payroll data. Ask about your employee roster, recent payroll runs, paycheck details, pay types, deductions and contributions, or time-off policies without having to hunt for the information yourself.


### See if you’re loan ready


**9. Lending:** Explore financing options informed by your QuickBooks data. Ask, “What loan options do I have?” to understand options that may be available to your business, including relevant terms, and determine what next steps you may be able to take directly in QuickBooks.


## Turn conversation into informed action


The


[Intuit QuickBooks Plugin in ChatGPT](https://openai.com/business/partners/quickbooks/?utm_medium=partner_click&utm_source=quickbooks_partnership&utm_campaign=PLG-SMB-Plugin-Promo-Pilot&utm_content=blog_content) brings the context of


***your*** business into ChatGPT, so your conversations are grounded in the actual financial data you already trust Intuit QuickBooks to manage. That means more relevant answers, more informed decisions, and clearer next steps—all in the flow of the conversation.


## Getting started


The


[Intuit QuickBooks Plugin in ChatGPT](https://openai.com/business/partners/quickbooks/?utm_medium=partner_click&utm_source=quickbooks_partnership&utm_campaign=PLG-SMB-Plugin-Promo-Pilot&utm_content=blog_content) , with its skills and tools, is available in ChatGPT. To try it, connect your QuickBooks account and start with a simple question such as:


- "How's my business doing this month?"


- "How am I doing compared to others in my industry?"


- "Who owes me money right now?"


- "Show me the details of my latest payroll, and how I can manage the costs."


- "What loan options do I have?"


To learn more,


[watch the webinar with OpenAI](https://webinar.openai.com/quickbooks-chatgpt/on-demand/) that walks you through these workflows in more depth, with demos of how business owners can turn financial insight into action, directly inside ChatGPT using their secure, QuickBooks data.


QuickBooks meets you where you already are. It remains your system of record for your business finances, while allowing you to connect its powerful platform to ChatGPT, giving you a faster way to understand and act while leveraging the ease and convenience of ChatGPT. When you connect your data through the QuickBooks plugin in ChatGPT, it's backed by the same compliance and security standards Intuit applies across QuickBooks. You stay in control of what's shared and what actions get taken with your business's financial data.
